title: Burglary in progress: torchlight in the house next door

caller.name: Raj Patel
caller.persona: hushed and urgent, watching from his bedroom window, steady but tense
caller.openingLine: Hi, yeah, police? I'm watching two blokes going through my neighbour's house right now. There's torchlight moving round the back room. The family's away, nobody should be in there.
dontKnowLines: I don't know, I'm not going out there.

incident.summaryTruth: Caller Raj Patel at 9 Chesham Close, Crawley, watching number 7 next door. Two males inside the neighbour's house using torches, entry apparently via the rear patio door. Homeowners the Okafors are on holiday. A white Transit-style van is parked outside with registration Kk19 XRD, engine possibly running. One male is tall in a dark hoodie, the other shorter carrying a holdall. No weapons seen. Caller is at his bedroom window at number 9, not confronting.

facts.label: Caller's name
facts.beat: Raj Patel. I'm at number 9, right next door.

facts.label: Target address
facts.beat: It's number 7, Chesham Close, Crawley. RH10 6JW. I'm at number 9 next door.

facts.label: Number of offenders
facts.beat: Two of them. Definitely two, I've seen both cross the landing.

facts.label: Descriptions
facts.value: one tall in a dark hoodie, one shorter with a holdall
facts.beat: One's tall, dark hoodie, hood up. The other one's shorter, he's carrying a big holdall. That's all I can make out.

facts.label: Vehicle and registration
facts.beat: There's a white van right outside, like a Transit. Reg is... hang on... KK19 XRD. K-K-one-nine, X-ray Romeo Delta.

facts.label: Point of entry
facts.beat: Round the back I think. The patio door at the back was the first place I saw the torch.

facts.label: Occupants away
facts.beat: The Okafors live there and they're away, Spain I think, back Sunday. That's how I know it's wrong, the house should be empty.

facts.label: Weapons
facts.beat: Haven't seen any weapons, just the torches and that holdall.

escalations.text: Informant states both males have left the property on foot towards the seafront carrying a holdall. Dark clothing, one in a grey beanie.
Informant now says one of the males is carrying what looks like a crowbar.
